head.title: Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up — Privacy Policy & Terms

div.p: Privacy, parental choices and terms of use for the families who play Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up.

div.div: A note for little creators: use a nickname for your pal, and ask a grown-up before sharing pictures.

article.p: Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up is an iOS character dress-up and adventure game designed for children and families. It is provided by [YOUR PUBLISHER NAME] (“we”, “us” or “our”). This policy explains the current game’s data practices and the hosting of this policy page.

The game saves pal names and appearances, outfits, completed adventures, stars, character and adventure unlocks, keepsakes, friendship hearts, bonus sparkles, and sound and motion settings. These records are used to restore your creations, preferences and progress.

Game records are stored locally on your iPhone or iPad. The game has no user account, publisher-operated game-data server or cloud-save service. The publisher cannot remotely access your local game records through the game.
The game does not ask for a real name, email address, date of birth, precise location, camera access or microphone access. Please use a nickname for saved pals and avoid entering personal details.

The iOS app integrates Google AdMob through the Google Mobile Ads SDK. Development builds use Google test ads. Live advertising is disabled in release builds unless explicitly configured and enabled by the publisher. When available, rewarded ads can unlock selected characters or adventures, interstitial ads may appear after completed adventures, and app-open ads may appear during startup or when returning to the home screen.

When the iOS advertising SDK operates, Google processes technical and advertising information. Depending on the SDK version and configuration, this can include IP addresses, approximate location inferred from an IP address, device or app identifiers, ad views and interactions, app interactions, crash reports and performance diagnostics. These data support ad delivery, measurement, diagnostics and fraud prevention. Test ads and non-personalized ads do not mean that no information is processed.

In the app’s grown-ups area, after a parental gate and explanation, a parent or guardian may open Apple’s App Tracking Transparency choice. The choice is optional and is not required for play or child-directed advertising. The app marks ad requests for child age treatment and non-personalized ads; Google states that this treatment prevents the iOS advertising identifier (IDFA) from being transmitted regardless of the ATT choice. The permission can later be reviewed in iOS Settings.

The current implementation configures child-directed ad treatment, a general-audience content rating and non-personalized ad requests. These settings do not eliminate every form of SDK data processing. No separate publisher analytics service or ad-mediation adapter is included in the current game.
Google’s practices and retention are described in its Privacy Policy. Google also describes iOS ad-SDK data processing.

Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up is designed for children. It does not provide public profiles, chat, public posting, or an account-registration form. Parents and guardians should supervise use and picture sharing.

The app-sharing, store-review and published-document links in Settings use a parent check. This interaction check is not identity verification or verifiable parental consent to collect personal information.

Where applicable law requires notice or parental consent for a particular data practice, that practice must not operate without the required notice and consent or a valid legal exception. Parents may contact us to request information about collection, review or deletion of a child’s information, or to refuse further collection or use. We will explain what is held locally, what information is handled by a provider, and the available steps for the request.
If you believe a child has provided personal information to us unintentionally, contact us at hindelouali01@gmail.com. Please do not include unnecessary information about the child.

Choosing to share the app sends the invitation text and any configured app link to the destination you select. Copy message places that invitation on your device’s clipboard. Saving a pal picture exports an image; sharing a picture sends the exported image and may include the pal name in the share title through your chosen app or service. Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up does not automatically upload your local pal collection to a public gallery.

Review buttons open the App Store listing when configured. External stores, websites, sharing services and ad providers process information under their own policies. Copies you share or download are managed separately from the game’s local records.

Local records remain until you delete them, clear the game’s storage, or otherwise remove that storage through your device. Individual saved pals can be deleted in My pals. Removing the app’s local data removes local progress, unlocks and settings. Device backups and restoration, if enabled, are controlled by your device or backup provider.

Clearing local game data does not automatically delete downloaded pictures, shared copies, emails, or information already processed by third-party providers. Contact us for privacy requests involving information sent to us; provider-held information is also subject to the provider’s retention and request procedures.

If you email us, we receive your email address and the message information you choose to send. We use this information to answer the request and keep it only as needed to handle the request and any applicable legal obligations. Please do not email passwords, identity documents or unnecessary child information.

Local records rely on your device’s storage protections. No storage or transmission method is completely secure. Protect access to your device and consider who can use its sharing and backup features.

This page is hosted by Google Blogger. Visiting it can involve Google processing technical information such as your IP address, browser or device information, and cookies or similar technologies. This website’s hosting is separate from local game storage.
See Google’s Privacy Policy and Google’s cookie information. Additional website widgets, advertising or analytics, if added by the publisher, must be reflected in an updated policy.

Depending on your location and applicable law, you or your child may have rights to access, correct, delete or restrict use of personal information, object to processing, or withdraw consent where processing relies on consent. Contact us using the details below to ask about these rights. We may need proportionate information to verify a request or parental authority.

We may update this policy when the game, providers or data practices change. The date at the top identifies the latest update. Where required, material changes will be accompanied by additional notice or consent before the affected practice begins.

article.h3: 1. Using Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up
article.p: Twinkle Pals: Kids Dress Up is provided for creative play and entertainment. Parents and guardians should review these terms and supervise children’s use. Use the game lawfully and do not attempt to compromise its security, interfere with other services, or distribute unlawful content through exported creations.

You may save and share pal pictures using the available features. Rights in the app’s code, original artwork, sounds and branding belong to the publisher or the relevant rights holders. Third-party components remain subject to their own licenses; open-source notices are available in Settings. These terms do not transfer ownership of the app or third-party material.

Stars, gifts, hearts and unlocks are game features with no cash value. Some characters and adventures require completion of an available rewarded ad. Closing an ad before its reward event does not grant the unlock. Ad availability is not guaranteed. Ratings and app sharing are optional and do not award game rewards.

The current game has no in-app purchases or account-based restoration. Progress is local and can be lost if storage is cleared, removed or corrupted. Keep separate copies of pictures you want to retain.

Stores, advertising providers and sharing destinations are independent services with their own terms. Features may depend on your device, internet access and provider availability. We may update or change the game, and uninterrupted availability or retention of local data cannot be guaranteed.
Nothing in these terms excludes or limits rights or protections that children, parents or other consumers have under applicable law.
Updates to these terms will be published here with a revised date. Questions about the game, these terms or privacy can be sent to the contact below.
